title: File verification for the Sintel fire-cauldron recreation
provenance: Sintel (Blender open movie), 1080p master frame 2800, copied byte-for-byte from the public media.xiph.org mirror. License CC BY 3.0 with the required attribution, verbatim: Sintel © Blender Foundation | durian.blender.org
production: The 3D scene is a production recreation, not an end-to-end pipeline output: the girl, shaman, cauldron fire, bowl, and wall panel were generated with Meshy image-to-3D from crops of the source frame, the scene was assembled in Blender, and the composition was refined interactively over five rounds with Astra assistance.

input_frame.note: Source frame 2800 copied unmodified; the pixels are a byte copy downloaded from the media.xiph.org mirror.

preview_image.note: Hero render (128 samples, 1920x818) used as the catalog card preview.

scene_content: The scene contains the shaman and the girl at the fire cauldron at night, with the hut wall and props; warm firelight as in the source frame.

verification.summary: The web GLB was checked by header parse (version, counts, extensions, no external URIs) and cross-checked against the build session's delivery validation; all textures are packed inline with no missing external images, and the scene haze was excluded from the export.

camera_note: The GLB embeds one camera, an eye-aligned build camera used while composing the scene; it is not a verified source-image camera. The catalog camera field is null and the viewer's reset returns to the default view.
validation_limits: From the build session's delivery validation: mesh silhouettes and geometric flames remain different from source (Astra render visual review).
From the build session's delivery validation: browser visual test not performed.
The flame is a simple geometric cone and differs from the fire in the source frame.
Meshy usage is recorded as credits in the private build session receipts, not USD; cost_usd is null.
The original high-poly build evidence is retained in the private build session, not in this repository.
